Source distinctions and conflicts

  • Figure 5 and surrounding prose print deposition charges in mC/cm²; Figures 7 and 9 use µC/cm². The monolayer reference is printed 222 mC/cm². Values and upper-limit equivalent-monolayer estimates remain as printed, without a silent factor-of-1000 correction.
  • Figure 2 caption and section introduction give 10 mM silver, whereas the Figure 2b discussion and Scheme 1 give 1.0 mM. The general preparation is 1 mM; Figure 3 separately specifies 1.5 mM. These contexts are not merged.
  • Figure 2d caption names n++-Si whereas its discussion assigns nondegenerate n-Si. The body-based assignment is exposed with this conflict.
  • Figure 7 contains four displayed histograms and lists four pulse durations, but its caption says five samples. The top panel mean 2.2 nm and sigma 2.4 nm differ from body values 2.4 nm and 2 nm. Four source panels are retained, not a reconstructed fifth specimen.
  • Figure 8 ordinate is particle density (µm−2) and its discussion concerns nucleation density, while its caption says mean height and height-distribution error bars. The axis/body interpretation is retained with ambiguous error-bar semantics.
  • Nucleation rates on printed p.797 use cm−2 ms−1, whereas the Summary uses cm−2 s−1. These are separately scoped statements, not a normalized rate label.
  • Table 1 prints expected FCC Ag (111) d spacing 2.32 Å versus experimental 2.37 Å. No corrected reference value is substituted.
  • Equation 2 includes an undefined A and does not show the F that appears in Equation 1. Preserve the original equation rather than silently repair it. The text on p.798 refers to Figure 8 for the size–charge model plotted in Figure 9.
